lowering_contract.kind_is: semantic plan category, not current controller enum
lowering_contract.method: After minimal controller patch, lower plan specs into validated appended task specs; never feed this JSON directly to current init/resume.

goal: Maximize solver-free completion of original research objectives and execute every distinct actionable method lane; do not manufacture 42/42

admission_rules.requires_all: all sufficient obligations for the same claim
admission_rules.requires_any: each branch independently sufficient for the same declared obligation; never different estimands
admission_rules.new_estimand: separate conditional task; explicit assumption and coverage target
admission_rules.same_data_new_method: valid semantic research delta; no new raw bytes required

continuation.on_one_task_complete: record raw result, independent review, then immediately select another actionable task
continuation.on_no_ready_tasks: inspect method frontier and typed obligation gaps; fixed-plan HOLD is not exhaustion
continuation.on_method_failure: record falsifying discriminator and reconsider assumptions/observable/nuisance class; continue independent lanes
continuation.two_failures: replan trigger, never permanent count-based termination
continuation.on_true_external_cut: preserve exact payload need, do other work; no repeated unsupported archive search
continuation.escalation: Verify current exact model/effort host capability, then use existing router; implementation spawn/ack/raw-result/record/next schedules review, then separate reviewer spawn/ack/raw-result/record/next. Preserve shared one-use repair IDs; requested != observed.
continuation.stop_condition: all distinct authorized executable frontier actions have reviewed discriminating outcomes, with remaining true external dependencies explicit; original overall goal remains incomplete if original criteria unmet

tasks.goal: Add append-only scientific frontier, typed obligations and semantic resume kinds to existing controller
tasks.discriminator: Reproduce recorded AND/OR, transport and label-only cases; regression tests preserve old task/packet/usage state
outputs: actual reviewed R24-DISTANCE-MODELS result, or reviewed source-specific input-gap discriminator if cache intake fails; a packet alone is insufficient
tasks.input_contract: Read owner AGENTS and pinned/current controller; use copied state for tests. Never init over production.

tasks.goal: Adapt existing full tensor/anchor/depth APIs; preserve typed functional/set/path outputs
tasks.discriminator: Same confidence-event ID and full transformed covariance; singular/undefined strata retained; scalar legacy replay only in eligible subcase
outputs: one observed or explicitly synthetic bundle
tasks.input_contract: Read July tensor plan and R9 revision2, current anchor_geometry/depth_path/tensor_functionals; historical branch-only implementations are not assumed integrated.

tasks.goal: Compare selected-cohort hierarchical calibration/PV and optical cosmography on the same retained cohort and window
tasks.discriminator: Method/direction/depth residual adequacy and held-out predictions; retain old failed T,p and report exploratory selection
tasks.input_contract: Recheck retained CF4 628-target/274-distance lineage, frames, group/method and already-included error components. Model-specific assumptions explicit.

tasks.goal: Compute overlap/selection-odds sensitivity envelopes for one declared functional
tasks.discriminator: Interval width and vacuity boundary versus justified Gamma/overlap; 274/628 is not a propensity; LP oracle
tasks.input_contract: Use new selected cohort model and declared bounded outcome/odds domain; arbitrary clipping is not a measured physical bound.

tasks.goal: Fit optical dipole/STF quadrupole and propagate a shear-sector interval under explicit finite-z response assumptions
tasks.discriminator: Joint H/shear/remainder bounds finite and nonvacuous or constructive failure; mask-mode mixing and alternative calibration included
tasks.input_contract: THEOREMS T1/T2/T7. Without qualified finite-z remainder and u-to-G map, report optical effective coefficient and scenario interval only.

tasks.goal: Compute full Q/O orbit/strata and support profiles with retained maps and frozen processing
tasks.discriminator: Retain degenerate charts; evaluate scalar-versus-full-tensor information and mask/operator sensitivity; do not invent calibrated p
tasks.input_contract: Pinned PR3 maps/masks/beams and retained eight pairs; exact tensor carrier convention; no PR4 as PR3 ensemble replacement.

tasks.goal: Compare common-contaminant/template/frequency nuisance envelopes and compute morphology sensitivity
tasks.discriminator: Split kernel and common-mode uncertainty both retained; certified worst-case bound or unbounded witness; calibrated p only with valid fixed-nuisance law
tasks.input_contract: T3/T5/T7. Cross-noise term included. Same-sky component maps not independent universes. No assumed common-mode bound from split differences.

tasks.goal: Extend retained-summary valid-domain power to spatial/common-error sensitivity and alternative depth/VSH responses
tasks.discriminator: Quantify attainable power and required information change within validity domain; no full catalogue replay unless needed for missing moments
tasks.input_contract: K03_INPUT and existing sufficient statistics. Optical/radio-centroid-to-matter law remains unknown. Reuse T6 rather than recompute identical rank6 fit.

tasks.goal: Compare local observer boost, intrinsic kinetic acceleration and calibration dipole in a common observable-response design
tasks.discriminator: Frame/unit-correct columns, rank and valid-domain power; intrinsic acceleration requires positive kinetic stress and qualified gradient/tracer information
tasks.input_contract: T1/T2; exact redshift/distance/angle transform; no dust law assigned to quasars; no ODE or inferred full global history.

tasks.goal: Analyze release-level distance/calibration functionals without requiring an unavailable historical training replay
tasks.discriminator: Public release covariance used once, shared nuisances explicit, historical nominal replay separately HOLD
tasks.input_contract: Retained Pantheon public data/total covariance and source inventory. New derivative labels require actual response computation or justified bounds.

tasks.goal: Construct full functional depth paths and joint images for each available qualified product subset
tasks.discriminator: Use Y or (Y0,DeltaY) and full covariance; common-state/anchor coverage identity; missing products leave their coordinates unavailable
outputs: Pi surfaces only for explicit source law
tasks.input_contract: Dynamic product qualification: completed research task is not sufficient evidence of valid coverage. Accept one or more independently qualified bundles; never wait for all products. If none qualify, exercise adapter on labeled reference example and retain exact missing law.

tasks.goal: Continuously update six paper candidates from reviewed new results, without waiting for every lane
tasks.discriminator: Separate actual findings, assumptions, original acceptance mappings and future predictions; no claim count equals manuscript readiness
tasks.input_contract: Consume only actual reviewed results as they arrive; final frontier closeout after every executable action has a discriminating result or exact unresolved trigger.
